description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IWebAudioPlayerModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC layer. It declares classes for creating and managing WebAudioPlayerModule services, including connection handling with IPC clients.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IWebAudioPlayerModuleService.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleService
classes.description: Interface for WebAudioPlayerModule service, handling IPC client connections.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a IWebAudioPlayerModuleService, given a reference to IWebAudioPlayerService.
